jobs.title: Chief of Staff (Office of the CBO)
jobs.description:
About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.
We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.
Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.
Summary
We are looking for an exceptional Chief of Staff to work directly with our Chief Business Officer and help drive some of the company’s highest-priority growth initiatives.
This is a unique opportunity for an ambitious, highly analytical generalist who wants broad exposure to how a high-growth technology company operates and scales. You will work across strategy, growth, go-to-market, operations, partnerships, new initiatives, and special projects—turning ideas into action and helping the CBO and leadership team move faster.
This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role focused primarily on meetings, presentations, or administration. You will be expected to own problems, build solutions, analyze opportunities, launch initiatives, and drive measurable business outcomes.
The ideal candidate has the mindset of a future entrepreneur: intellectually curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, highly analytical, and energized by building from zero to one. The role is particularly suited for someone who ultimately wants to build or lead a company of their own.

What you’ll be doing
Drive Strategic Growth Initiatives

-
Partner directly with the Chief Business Officer to identify, prioritize, and execute the company’s most important growth initiatives

-
Own strategic projects from initial hypothesis and analysis through execution, measurement, and iteration

-
Evaluate new markets, customer segments, products, partnerships, and business models that could accelerate company growth

-
Conduct market, competitive, customer, and financial analysis to identify new opportunities

-
Build business cases and translate insights into clear recommendations and action plans

-
Help launch and operationalize new initiatives, stepping in wherever needed to get them from 0 → 1

Operate Across the Business

-
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Operations, and other teams to move critical initiatives forward

-
Serve as a connective layer between the CBO and teams across the organization, ensuring priorities translate into execution

-
Identify organizational or operational bottlenecks and develop practical solutions

-
Establish operating mechanisms, dashboards, metrics, and processes that create greater accountability and visibility

-
Lead projects where ownership may initially be unclear and build the structure required to make them successful

-
Step into emerging business needs and special situations where additional leadership and problem-solving are needed

Turn Data Into Decisions

-
Analyze business performance, pipeline, customer behavior, market trends, and other data to identify opportunities and risks

-
Develop models, analyses, and dashboards that help leadership make faster, better-informed decisions

-
Bring structured thinking to ambiguous problems and distill complex information into simple recommendations

-
Track the impact of strategic initiatives and proactively adjust plans based on results

-
Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technology to accelerate research, analysis, execution, and internal productivity
We’ll be excited if you have
-
Approximately 2-3 years of high-impact professional experience, ideally across management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, technology, startups, strategy, business operations, or another highly analytical environment.

-
Strong academic background from a top Indian university. Examples may include I ITs, IIMs, ISB, BITS Pilani, Delhi University, NITs, or other highly selective institutions.

-
Exceptional creative, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills

-
Strong business judgment with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar industries, markets, and problems

-
Comfortable working with data, financial models, business cases, and performance metrics

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives

-
Highly organized and able to manage multiple fast-moving priorities without losing attention to detail

-
AI-native and technology-savvy, with curiosity around how emerging technology can transform the way businesses operate and grow

-
Experience working in or closely with high-growth startups strongly preferred

-
Bias toward action—you would rather build a first version, test it, learn, and improve than spend excessive time pursuing perfection

-
Low ego and comfortable doing whatever is necessary to get an important initiative across the finish line

- Ability to work U.S. business hours
Location
The role is remote. For remote, we are looking for candidates based in India.
Don’t hold back
We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past.  As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Business Development & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

Summary

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Business Development & Partnerships Manager to own visible, impactful non-linear growth initiatives by identifying, developing, and managing strategic partnership opportunities for Firework. This role will work across external partners and internal teams to support new partnerships, product integrations, and broader strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is someone ready to take the next step up in their career, comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, can operate with ambiguity, and is able to take ownership of projects from early-stage discussions through execution. You will work closely with senior members of the team while also independently managing partner communications, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, and helping move opportunities forward.
What you'll be doing
-
Support the development and execution of strategic partnerships across technology platforms, retailers, brands, agencies, and other ecosystem partners

-
Manage day-to-day partner relationships and communications, including with senior external stakeholders

-
Identify new partnership and business development opportunities and support outreach, evaluation, and follow-up

-
Help structure partnership proposals, commercial models, business cases, and internal recommendations

-
Coordinate partnership discussions across internal teams including Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal

-
Support API-led and product integration partnerships, working with Product and Engineering teams to understand partner requirements, timelines, and implementation needs

-
Track partnership progress, dependencies, deliverables, and next steps to ensure initiatives continue moving forward

-
Prepare presentations, proposals, meeting materials, and executive-level communications for internal and external audiences

-
Conduct research and analysis on potential partners, market opportunities, competitors, and broader industry trends

-
Support broader strategic initiatives, including selected corporate development or strategic evaluation projects where relevant
We’ll be excited if you have
-
3+ years of professional experience, ideally in partnerships, business development, strategy, consulting, corporate development, or a related role

-
Exceptional communication skills and the ability to interact confidently and professionally with senior external stakeholders

-
Demonstrated ability to take ownership, work independently, and proactively move projects forward

-
Comfortable operating in an environment where priorities and opportunities may not always be clearly defined

-
Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and workstreams

-
Strong analytical skills and comfort developing business cases, presentations, and recommendations

-
Ability to understand commercial and product considerations and translate between different internal teams

-
Experience working on API integrations, technology partnerships, platform integrations, or other product-led partnerships is highly valued

-
Experience in Ad Tech, Retail Media Networks, commerce technology, SaaS, or related industries is a plus, but not required

-
Exposure to corporate development, M&A, strategic investments, or transaction-related work is a plus

-
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is revolutionizing connected commerce with the world’s most advanced and largest AI-powered video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. We bring the energy of in-store experiences online, transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships.
At Firework, you’ll be part of a high-growth, team-centric environment where innovation thrives and collaboration fuels success. Having raised over $235m to date led by investors such as the SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and operating at a global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work cross-functionally, solve complex challenges, and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected digital commerce.
If you’re curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas, Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape the next era of online shopping—together.
Summary
Our team is responsible for offering strategic customer success relationship management to existing clients who leverage our innovative commerce solutions to drive their business growth. We’re looking for an experienced customer success professional to join our team to nurture and grow our enterprise customers across the North America market. You are client-focused, data-driven, and excited to establish and maintain close growth-oriented partnerships with a diverse portfolio.

What you’ll be doing
-
Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts across brands and retailers, serving as the primary strategic partner and building long-term, mutually beneficial customer relationships

-
Drive customer lifetime value by identifying expansion and cross-sell opportunities, mitigating churn risk, and partnering cross-functionally to support revenue growth

-
Own the end-to-end post-sale customer journey, including onboarding, integration, adoption, utilization analysis, ROI measurement, and strategic recommendations

-
Forecast, lead, and negotiate renewals and expansion opportunities to improve retention and net revenue retention, partnering closely with Sales and Revenue Operations

-
Serve as the voice of the customer, translating customer needs and feedback into actionable insights for Product and other cross-functional teams while driving measurable adoption outcomes

-
Analyze product usage, customer behavior, and performance data to deliver proactive insights, value-based recommendations, and personalized engagement strategies

-
Lead executive business reviews and strategic check-ins that clearly demonstrate business impact, ROI, progress against goals, and opportunities for continued growth

-
Manage day-to-day customer operations, including month-end billing review, internal coordination, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of customer processes and documentation
We’ll be excited if you have
-
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience

-
7+ years of customer success, account management, or strategic relationship management experience supporting U.S. enterprise customers, ideally within B2B SaaS

-
A proven track record of managing and improving commercial KPIs such as renewal rate, expansion, net revenue retention (NRR), and churn

-
Strong commercial and product acumen, with demonstrated experience contributing to customer growth and revenue outcomes

-
Strong technical aptitude and comfort using AI, analytics, and data tools to improve customer insights, efficiency, and decision-making

-
Experience with CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce and Gainsight is preferred.

-
Exceptional attention to detail, strong prioritization skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, startup environment

-
Excellent communication, relationship-building, and consultative skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives

-
A balanced mix of analytical rigor, creativity, problem-solving, and customer empathy

-
Ability to work U.S. business hours
Locations
The role will be remote in India working US hours. Preference will be for Mumbai or Bangalore based candidates.
Don’t hold back
